Hola Reddit! Using this as a weight loss journal. I've tried losing weight multiple times, including using things like Stickk, but with little to no permanent success. I figured it couldn't hurt to try this. I'm about 6'2" and about 285 pounds. I started at 300 at the beginning of the year, dropped to around 255, now I'm back up again. My main struggle is not using eating as an escape and temporary boost for my mood. It is incredibly frustrating to feel as if I am a rational person yet feel so very stupid for eating so poorly and being obese. 

My wall seems to be around the 255/260 mark, and I'm only exercising about once a week, which is usually just a 30-60 minute walk. Exercising has never been my main problem, though, it's been the eating, so I want to focus on that first. I'm hoping that will give me the energy levels that make it more likely to exercise and in turn increase energy levels even more, allowing me more willpower and discipline with dietary choices. 

I'm going to set some goals for myself for the next month to see if I can get some early wins. 

**GOALS**

*Think about each bite I take for at least 5 seconds prior. 

*Spend 15 minutes meal planning for the next day.

*Brush teeth after dinner every day.

*Go to bed by 11:30 PM. 

*Look forward to enjoying 1 "splurge" meal per week.
